text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Wellesley Street West, City Council approval of this report is required. In addition, this report proposes the temporarily removal of the cycle track on the north side of Wellesley Street West abutting the development. Based on these conditions, this matter requires final approval by City Council. Wellesley Street Nickolas Residences Limited Partnership is constructing a 55-storey residential development building at 6-16 Wellesley Street West and 5-7 St. Nicholas Street. The site is located on the north side of Wellesley Street West, west of Yonge Street between Bistro Lane and St. Nickolas Street. City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the closure of the north sidewalk and a 2.3-metre-wide portion of the eastbound curb lane on Wellesley Street West, between Bistro Lane and St. Nicholas Street, and provision of a temporary pedestrian walkway within the closed portion of the eastbound curb lane from July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022. 2. City Council authorize the closure of all of St. Nicholas Street, between Wellesley Street West and a point 43 metres north, from July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022. 3.City Council rescind the existing designated cycle track on the north side of Wellesley Street West, between Yonge Street and a point 20 metres west of St. Nicholas Street. 4.
